/* selectPopupCount - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM ( SELECT G.POPUP_NO, G.POPUP_NM, G.POPUP_DTL_CN, G.POPUP_WDTH_SIZEA_SZ, G.POPUP_VRTICL_SIZEA_SZ, G.PSTG_PRD_BGNG_DT, G.PSTG_PRD_END_DT, G.THTDAY_UNFOLL_INDCT_YN, G.PSTG_STTS_YN, G.RM_CN,
G.SRTNG_CRTR_VALUE, G.LESI_LC_VALUE, G.UPDRC_LC_VALUE, G.OPEN_LC_VALUE,
G.FRST_RGTR_ID, G.FRST_REG_DT, G.LAST_MDFR_ID, G.LAST_MDFCN_DT,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN D.FLNM_ENCPT WHEN E.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '____' || E.INST_NM WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN F.FLNM_ENCPT ELSE '' END AS FRST_RGTR_NM
FROM SAB970 G /* 팝업창 관리 */
LEFT JOIN SAA200 C /* 사용자 */ ON C.USER_ID = G.FRST_RGTR_ID
LEFT JOIN SCA100 D /* 종사자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 E /* 통합기관 */ ON E.INST_NO = D.OGDP_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA200 F /* 청소년학부모 */ ON F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
AND G.POPUP_NM LIKE '%' || #{POPUP_NM} || '%'
AND G.PSTG_PRD_BGNG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{OPEN_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND G.PSTG_PRD_END_DT >= TO_DATE(#{OPEN_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND G.PSTG_STTS_YN = #{PSTG_STTS_YN}
AND G.RM_CN LIKE '%' || #{RM_CN} || '%'
) X
AND (X.FRST_RGTR_NM = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{FRST_RGTR_NM}) OR X.FRST_RGTR_NM = '____' || #{FRST_RGTR_NM})

/* selectPopupList - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT ROWNUM AS SEQ, X.POPUP_NO, X.POPUP_NM, X.POPUP_DTL_CN, X.POPUP_WDTH_SIZEA_SZ, X.POPUP_VRTICL_SIZEA_SZ, TO_CHAR(X.PSTG_PRD_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS PSTG_PRD_BGNG_DT, TO_CHAR(X.PSTG_PRD_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS PSTG_PRD_END_DT, X.THTDAY_UNFOLL_INDCT_YN, X.PSTG_STTS_YN, X.RM_CN,
X.SRTNG_CRTR_VALUE, X.LESI_LC_VALUE, X.UPDRC_LC_VALUE, X.OPEN_LC_VALUE,
X.FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(X.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS FRST_REG_DT, X.LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(X.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT, X.FRST_RGTR_NM
FROM ( SELECT G.POPUP_NO, G.POPUP_NM, G.POPUP_DTL_CN, G.POPUP_WDTH_SIZEA_SZ, G.POPUP_VRTICL_SIZEA_SZ, G.PSTG_PRD_BGNG_DT, G.PSTG_PRD_END_DT, G.THTDAY_UNFOLL_INDCT_YN, G.PSTG_STTS_YN, G.RM_CN,
G.SRTNG_CRTR_VALUE, G.LESI_LC_VALUE, G.UPDRC_LC_VALUE, G.OPEN_LC_VALUE,
G.FRST_RGTR_ID, G.FRST_REG_DT, G.LAST_MDFR_ID, G.LAST_MDFCN_DT,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN C##RG.DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) WHEN E.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN E.INST_NM WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN C##RG.DEC_B64(F.FLNM_ENCPT) ELSE '' END AS FRST_RGTR_NM
FROM SAB970 G /* 팝업창 관리 */
LEFT JOIN SAA200 C /* 사용자 */ ON C.USER_ID = G.FRST_RGTR_ID
LEFT JOIN SCA100 D /* 종사자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 E /* 통합기관 */ ON E.INST_NO = D.OGDP_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA200 F /* 청소년학부모 */ ON F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
AND G.POPUP_NM LIKE '%' || #{POPUP_NM} || '%'
AND G.PSTG_PRD_BGNG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{OPEN_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND G.PSTG_PRD_END_DT >= TO_DATE(#{OPEN_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND G.PSTG_STTS_YN = #{PSTG_STTS_YN}
AND G.RM_CN LIKE '%' || #{RM_CN} || '%'
) X
AND (X.FRST_RGTR_NM = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{FRST_RGTR_NM}) OR X.FRST_RGTR_NM = '____' || #{FRST_RGTR_NM})
ORDER BY X.FRST_REG_DT DESC OFFSET #{OFFSET_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* selectNoticePopupList - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT G.POPUP_NO, G.POPUP_NM, G.POPUP_DTL_CN, G.POPUP_WDTH_SIZEA_SZ, G.POPUP_VRTICL_SIZEA_SZ, TO_CHAR(G.PSTG_PRD_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS PSTG_PRD_BGNG_DT, TO_CHAR(G.PSTG_PRD_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS PSTG_PRD_END_DT, G.THTDAY_UNFOLL_INDCT_YN, G.PSTG_STTS_YN, G.RM_CN,
G.SRTNG_CRTR_VALUE, G.LESI_LC_VALUE, G.UPDRC_LC_VALUE, G.OPEN_LC_VALUE,
G.FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(G.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS FRST_REG_DT, G.LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(G.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAB970 G /* 팝업창 관리 */
WHERE G.PSTG_PRD_BGNG_DT <= SYSDATE AND G.PSTG_PRD_END_DT >= SYSDATE AND G.PSTG_STTS_YN = 'Y'
AND OPEN_LC_VALUE = 'INNER'
AND OPEN_LC_VALUE = 'OUTER'
ORDER BY G.FRST_REG_DT ASC
